description: Resolve which Space Monkey projects this API key can read. Call this first when the user names a company rather than a project ID, and match on companyName — never silently mix projects.
name: sm_list_projects

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_list_projects tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

projects.description: Project rows this key can read.

companyName.description: Company associated with the project, or null when unset.

id.description: 8-char Hashid of the internal integer id.

title: List projects
